title: dot-me preferences.yaml
description: Schema for ~/.me/preferences.yaml. Tracks SPEC.md §5.3. All top-level keys are optional. Nested keys are free-form; the likes / favorites / avoid triad is the convention but not enforced. additionalProperties is true everywhere per SPEC §5.6 (unknown keys MUST be tolerated by consumers).

tools.description: Editor, shell, runtime, package manager, etc. Each value is free-form so adopters can record whatever shape fits (single string, list, nested object).

aesthetics.description: formality, color_temperature, density, and similar surface-level preferences.

media.description: games, movies, music, books, etc. Each category SHOULD use the likes / favorites / avoid triad when applicable, but the schema does not enforce it.

workflow.description: commit_messages, branching, review rituals — anything that shapes how work moves through your tools.

notes.description: Trailing free-form block for cross-cutting preferences that don't fit a category.
